}}'''Votabek''' is a [[Domani]] soldier who was in the King's Guard.

== Activities ==
After King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]] goes missing, the King's Guard is disbanded by [[Milisair Chadmar]]. Votebek becomes a street tough guarding rich merchants. When [[Rand al'Thor]] returned to [[Bandar Eban]], he promoted Votabek to lieutenant and charged him with the duty of restoring order to the city.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Votabek}}

== Trivia == 
* Votabek is named for Nicholas Votrobeck, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
